summary: Westamerica Bancorporation filed an 8-K announcing a quarterly cash dividend increase to $0.48 per share, up $0.02 (4.3%) from the prior quarter. Record date is May 4, 2026, payable May 15, 2026. The filing is solely a capital return event with no M&A, activist, or restructuring context. The increase reflects the company's reliable earnings and financial strength. No advisors or board recommendations beyond management commentary are noted. The registrant is the issuer. There is no regulatory clock, deal mechanics, or risk-arb angle; the event is a routine dividend hike classified as a capital return.
